name: @hafley66/docs-kit
description: The documentation site apparatus every package in this workspace shares: the live demo panel, the in-view runner, the receipts renderer, the doc lint, and the API reference generator.
//: vite, vitepress, vue and playwright are peers rather than devDependencies on purpose: a second copy of any of them in this package's own node_modules is a second Vue app instance, or a second @vitest/browser, which is what a duplicate vite resolution produced the first time this was written.
